metadata.description: Curated active-party recommendations based on current Pal Partner Skills.

guides.title: All-Purpose Fishing Party
guides.summary: More loot, easier catches, talented-Pal odds, and fast travel between fishing spots.
guides.tip: Ghangler is the travel slot in current 1.0 data. Swap it for Galeclaw or Dogen when another movement option suits the route better.

members.name: Jelliette
members.effect: Increases items obtained from fishing and scales with condensation.

members.name: Gloopie
members.effect: Slows capture-gauge loss when the fishing bars separate.

members.name: Whalaska Ignis
members.effect: Starts the fishing gauge higher and increases progress while aligned.

members.name: Solmora Lux
members.effect: Improves talented-Pal odds and serves as a Water mount.

members.name: Ghangler
members.effect: Travels on water and gains speed from other Dark or Water party members.

guides.title: Ocean-Salvage Party
guides.summary: Increase salvage rewards and support a combined fishing-and-salvage route.
guides.tip: Jellroy is the essential salvage booster. Gloopie and Whalaska Ignis assist fishing encounters between salvage spots, not the salvage timing circle itself.

members.name: Jellroy
members.effect: Increases items obtained from successful salvage spots.

members.name: Gloopie
members.effect: Makes fishing encounters between salvage stops more forgiving.

members.name: Whalaska Ignis
members.effect: Improves the starting gauge and aligned progress during fishing.

members.name: Solmora Lux
members.effect: Provides Water travel between offshore salvage spots.

members.name: Dogen
members.effect: Teleports to the nearest base after the run.

guides.title: General Capturing Party
guides.summary: Combine back-bonus and status-based capture boosts with safe chip damage.
guides.tip: Damage the target, apply Freeze or Ivy-Covered, move behind it, then throw your best affordable sphere. The back bonus can combine with a status bonus.

members.name: Wispaw
members.effect: Improves capture rate when a throw receives the back bonus.

members.name: Muffly
members.effect: Improves capture rate against Frozen Pals.

members.name: Souffline
members.effect: Improves capture rate against Ivy-Covered Pals.

members.name: Daedream
members.effect: Necklace attacks cannot lower the target below 1 HP.

members.name: Jetragon
members.effect: Closes distance quickly while searching for targets.

guides.title: Passive-Skill Hunting Party
guides.summary: Use Yakumo to search for wild Pals carrying specific eligible passives.
guides.tip: Give Yakumo only the one or two passives you actually want. Yakumo must be actively fighting, and exclusive passives are excluded.

members.name: Yakumo
members.effect: Raises the chance of encountering Pals with the same eligible passives.

members.name: Wispaw
members.effect: Improves capture rate on successful back-bonus throws.

members.name: Muffly
members.effect: Improves capture rate against Frozen targets.

members.name: Daedream
members.effect: Assists without reducing the target below 1 HP.

members.name: Souffline
members.effect: Improves capture rate against Ivy-Covered targets.

guides.title: Wild-Egg Gathering Party
guides.summary: Improve wild-egg pickups while covering travel, movement, and the return trip.
guides.tip: Grintale and Broncherry Aqua do not benefit from duplicate copies. Condense the single Pal used in each slot.

members.name: Grintale
members.effect: Can provide one additional Pal Egg when an egg is picked up.

members.name: Broncherry Aqua
members.effect: Can convert a collected Pal Egg into an Alpha Pal Egg.

members.name: Jetragon
members.effect: Rapidly covers long egg routes.

members.name: Verdash
members.effect: Adds an extra jump and mid-air dash while in the party.

members.name: Dogen
members.effect: Teleports to the nearest base after the route.

guides.title: Ore & Chromite Party
guides.summary: Mine ore manually, locate Chromite, and get overloaded resources home quickly.
guides.tip: Smokie must fight alongside you for its Chromite acquisition bonus. Replace it with extra carrying or travel support on ordinary ore runs.

members.name: Astegon
members.effect: Deals heavy ore damage and increases ore yield while mounted.

members.name: Smokie
members.effect: Detects nearby Chromite and increases the amount acquired.

members.name: Cattiva
members.effect: Raises maximum carrying capacity.

members.name: Dogen
members.effect: Teleports to the nearest base when the run is complete.

members.name: Galeclaw
members.effect: Provides fast gliding between deposits.

guides.title: Pal Soul Farming Party
guides.summary: Make Nitemary the reliable reward core and use the remaining slots to clear targets faster.
guides.tip: Nitemary must fight alongside you. Whether an elemental drop booster affects the same Soul table can vary, so treat it as an optional slot.

members.name: Nitemary
members.effect: Increases Pal Souls dropped by defeated Pals.

members.name: Match the target element
members.effect: Use the elemental reference below when its bonus applies to the target.

members.name: Solenne
members.effect: Raises player Attack when all party Pals are different species.

members.name: Gobfin
members.effect: Adds another player Attack bonus.

members.name: Strong combat Pal
members.effect: Use your strongest active attacker or fastest suitable mount.

guides.title: Gold Coin Farming Party
guides.summary: Increase Gold Coin drops while stacking distinct bonuses that improve clear speed.
guides.tip: Dumud Gild is the essential member and duplicate copies do not stack. Keep every species unique so Solenne remains active.

members.name: Dumud Gild
members.effect: Increases Gold Coins dropped by defeated enemies.

members.name: Solenne
members.effect: Raises player Attack when every party Pal is a different species.

members.name: Gobfin
members.effect: Increases player Attack from the party.

members.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
members.effect: Improves player damage against enemy weak points.

members.name: Strong active Pal
members.effect: Use a strong combat Pal or elemental mount suited to the route.

guides.title: Elemental-Material Farming Party
guides.summary: Match one drop booster to the target's element, then use four slots to increase kill speed.
guides.tip: Choose the booster by the defeated Pal's element—not your attack element. Current 1.0 assignments appear in the reference below.

members.name: Element drop booster
members.effect: Choose the matching Pal from the enemy-drop reference below.

members.name: Solenne
members.effect: Raises player Attack in a unique-species party.

members.name: Gobfin
members.effect: Raises player Attack from the party.

members.name: Vanwyrm Cryst
members.effect: Increases player weak-point damage.

members.name: Counter-element Pal
members.effect: Use a strong Pal whose element counters the target.

guides.title: Meat Cleaver Party
guides.summary: Maximize manual Meat Cleaver rewards and support movement, carrying, healing, and return travel.
guides.tip: Splatterina is the only required Pal. Do not assume the bonus affects the Pal Disassembly Conveyor unless that interaction is confirmed in-game.

members.name: Splatterina
members.effect: Substantially increases items obtained with the Meat Cleaver.

members.name: Dogen
members.effect: Teleports to the nearest base.

members.name: Cattiva
members.effect: Raises maximum carrying capacity.

members.name: Galeclaw
members.effect: Provides fast gliding while retaining weapon use.

members.name: Celesdir
members.effect: Recovers Health for the player and party Pals over time.

guides.title: Party-Leveling Team
guides.summary: Boost party experience while one strong Pal clears encounters for three trainees.
guides.tip: Omascul's experience bonus does not stack. Make the combat slot strong enough to clear bosses or dense enemy groups quickly.

members.name: Omascul
members.effect: Increases experience gained by the other party Pals.

members.name: Strong combat Pal
members.effect: Use a powerful Pal capable of quickly clearing high-value encounters.

members.name: Pal being leveled
members.effect: Place one of the Pals you want to train in this slot.

members.name: Pal being leveled
members.effect: Place another Pal you want to train in this slot.

members.name: Pal being leveled
members.effect: Use the final slot for another Pal that needs experience.

guides.title: Exploration & Treasure Party
guides.summary: Search islands, dungeons, treasure chests, scrap, and dark areas efficiently.
guides.tip: Tombat's scanner must be activated; it is not a constant passive radar. Dogen cannot teleport from every restricted area.

members.name: Jetragon
members.effect: Covers long exploration routes quickly.

members.name: Tombat
members.effect: Detects nearby dungeons, treasure chests, and scrap when activated.

members.name: Cawgnito
members.effect: Toggles Night Vision for dark areas.

members.name: Galeclaw
members.effect: Provides fast gliding while retaining weapon use.

members.name: Dogen
members.effect: Teleports to the nearest base when exploration is complete.

guides.title: Safe Material-Gathering Party
guides.summary: Keep targets alive until you decide whether capturing or defeating them gives the better reward.
guides.tip: Use Wispaw and Muffly when capturing. Use Nitemary or the matching elemental booster when you decide to defeat the target.

members.name: Daedream
members.effect: Necklace attacks cannot reduce the target below 1 HP.

members.name: Wispaw
members.effect: Improves capture rate on back-bonus throws.

members.name: Muffly
members.effect: Improves capture rate against Frozen targets.

members.name: Nitemary
members.effect: Increases Pal Soul drops when it fights alongside you.

members.name: Jetragon
members.effect: Moves quickly between material targets.
